wire.radient_saver.section.title: Radient Saver (beta)
wire.radient_saver.section.description: Shortens the conversation history your agent re-sends on every turn. Saver never sends your AI provider's credentials to Radient. Changes apply from the next turn.
wire.radient_saver.mode.label: Radient Saver (beta)
wire.radient_saver.mode.help: Beta. Sends Radient the history ready to be shortened; Radient keeps none of it. Saver never sends your AI provider's credentials to Radient. Saver charges only your Radient credits, priced on the tokens it removes, never your provider account; it needs a Radient sign-in with credit. Your provider still bills what it receives on its own terms. LOP_RADIENT_SAVER overrides this setting.
wire.radient_saver.mode.choice.off.label: off
wire.radient_saver.mode.choice.off.descr: never sends history to Radient (the default)
wire.radient_saver.mode.choice.opt_in.de: available, but off until a session turns it on
wire.radient_saver.notice.unavailable: Radient Saver is unavailable right now, so this turn sends your full history. Nothing else is affected.
wire.radient_saver.notice.rejected: Radient Saver returned a response that failed its safety checks, so it was discarded and this turn sends your full history.
wire.radient_saver.notice.signed_out: Radient Saver is paused for this session because you are not signed in to Radient. Run /login radient to use it.
wire.radient_saver.notice.no_credit: Radient Saver is paused for this session because your Radient balance is empty. Add credit at console.radienthq.com to use it.
wire.radient_saver.notice.rate_limited: Radient Saver is busy, so your full history is sent until it accepts requests again.
wire.radient_saver.notice.disabled: Radient Saver is not available for this request, so your whole conversation is sent. Nothing else is affected.
wire.radient_saver.notice.oversize: One message in this conversation is too large for Radient Saver, so it stays unshortened. Saver keeps working on the rest of the conversation.
wire.radient_saver.command.description: Set Radient Saver for this session
wire.radient_saver.command.usage: Use /saver or /radient saver, then on, off, status or inherit. Bare /saver toggles; inherit follows the global setting.
wire.radient_saver.command.enabled: Radient Saver is on for this session. Your global setting is unchanged.
wire.radient_saver.command.disabled: Radient Saver is off for this session. Your global setting is unchanged; /saver inherit follows it again.
wire.radient_saver.command.inherited: Radient Saver now follows the global setting and agent designation for this session.
wire.radient_saver.command.status.on: Radient Saver: on for this session. Use /saver off to disable it or /saver inherit to follow the global setting.
wire.radient_saver.command.status.off: Radient Saver: off for this session. Use /saver on to enable it; if the global setting is off, turn it on in /settings under Radient Saver.
wire.radient_saver.notice.unknown_balanc: Radient Saver could not check your Radient balance just now, so nothing changed. Try /saver on again in a moment.
wire.radient_saver.notice.no_session: Radient Saver needs an open conversation; open one and try again.
wire.radient_saver.notice.gate_off: Radient Saver is off in your settings, so this session cannot turn it on. Turn it on in /settings under Radient Saver, then /saver on.
